content: Homage to the Dharma King Tsongkhapa.In the vast sky of your wisdom,You possess the light rays of knowing all that is and all that exists;O Son of the Victors, Sun, Venerable Lord of Dharma,I hold the dust of your feet, glorious Guru, upon the crown of my head.The qualities of your body, speech, and mindCannot be fully described even by the Victors and their heirsResiding in the ten directions; nevertheless,Listen briefly to what I offer with faith.This garland of praise, a flower of oceanic qualities,Is an ornament for the throats of the wise, well-composed;May this precious means of increasing the merit of faith,Which I have fashioned, be pleasing to the learned.The clouds of your well-wrought meritRain down a continuous stream to increase the virtue of those to be tamed;Resounding with the thunder of profound and vast renown,You are like the king of rain clouds, glorious Guru.Mastering myriad tens of millions of meditative concentrations,Intensely devoted to composing and practicing the excellent teachings,Lord of yogis, foremost of all who hold the knowledge of mantra,Glorious Guru, you are supreme upon the crown of all beings.In the past, at Vajrāsana, before the Victorious One,You offered a precious crystal rosary of one hundred and one beads,Generated the mind of enlightenment, and having done so,Became a fortunate one who realized the authentic view.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.From the age of seven, the Lord of Secrets andThe great chariot, the glorious Dīpaṃkara,Were beheld directly and continuously cared for you.The scriptures of mantra and the perfections dawned as instructions.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.Possessing a lattice of five-colored, radiant light rays,Deeply blue like the color of indranīla sapphire.In the center of that perfect sphere, MañjughoṣaWas beheld directly by the venerable Lord of Dharma.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.From that time on, venerable one, treasury of wisdom.Beholding them whenever desired, the glorious Guhyasamāja andThe profound meaning of the scriptures of the Perfection of Wisdom,You listened to continuously, O Bodhisattva Lord of Dharma.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.When performing the ritual of the seven branches,The thirty-five Buddhas were beheld directly,With their respective body forms, hand symbols, and so forth,Just as they are, continuously beheld, O Lord of Dharma.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.With hands in the mudrā of teaching the Dharma,The Protector Maitreya, seated in the auspicious posture,Appeared just as the one who possesses the ten powers.Foretold to accomplish the deeds of the Victors,At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.The Teacher of gods and humans, the King of the Śākyas,The Medicine Buddha, and the Guide Amitābha.Radiantly present in the midst of an ocean-like assembly,Beheld directly, O Bodhisattva Lord of Dharma.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.And the Venerable Tārā, the source of accomplishments.Uṣṇīṣavijayā, the noble goddess Raśmivimalā,And the dispeller of all obstacles, Uṣṇīṣasitātapatrā, and others—May I behold these supreme deities clearly again and again.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.The Bodhisattva Nāgārjuna, the noble Buddhapālita,Āryadeva, and the feet of the glorious Candrakīrti,The lord of yogis, Kṛṣṇacārya,May you appear in person and always care for me.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.The noble Asaṅga, who attained the three levels,The second omniscient one, the Bodhisattva Vasubandhu,And Dignāga, who was cared for by the Noble One—May you appear in person and always care for me.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.The moon of speakers, Dharmakīrti,Guṇaprabha, and the Bodhisattva Śākyaprabha—Śāntideva and the glorious Abhayākaragupta,May you appear in person and always care for me.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.Indrabhūti and the glorious Saraha.Lūipa and the feet of the venerable Ghaṇṭapa,Kṛṣṇapa, Padmavajra, and others,May you appear in person and always care for me.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.Relying on the treatises of these masters,An auspicious connection for accomplishing great benefit for self and others,As clearly prophesied by Mañjughoṣa,The great Bodhisattva who spontaneously accomplishes the welfare of others—At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.Through the yoga of the union of calm abiding and special insight,As my meditative concentration increases like the waxing moon,The glorious Vajrabhairava, most majestic,Behold the supreme form, complete with all faces and arms.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.From the connection with the sword of wisdomAt the heart of Mañjughoṣa and the venerable Guru,A stream of untainted nectar enters my heart,And excellent meditative concentration of coemergent bliss is born.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.And the aspiration prayer for rebirth in Sukhāvatī—Praise to the authentic meaning of the Protector Mipham,Whose essence and order MañjughoṣaClearly explained, and whose words were well-composed—At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.When performing the consecration of the supports of body, speech, and mind,The primordial wisdom enters the commitment-being directly;The assembly of deities, blessed by whom,Are perfectly established as a field of merit for all beings.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.The Conqueror’s son Nāgārjuna, father and spiritual sons, the five principals and their retinue,Engaged in a discussion on the profound dependent origination;Among them, the glorious Buddhapālita,Blessed by the Sanskrit manuscript, gave rise to the realization of the Noble One’s intent—At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.When contemplating the vital points of the six branchesOf the glorious Kālacakra, the ultimate of tantras,You directly behold the mandala of the Blessed One,Prophesied to be like the fine moon—At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.At the time of the Great Miracle Festival in the Dharma-wheel of Lhasa,Having blessed the hundredfold wondrous and auspicious offeringsInto the nature of great bliss,You please the Victors of the ten directions and their spiritual heirs.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.Through the yoga of the non-duality of the profound and the luminous,Where the ordinary world and its inhabitants appear as illusory emptiness,At the moment of arising in the form of the deity of great bliss,Lord of the Dharma of the Vajra Body yoga,At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.When reciting the resonance of the mantra of the Three Kayas’ vajraWithin the lotus of the heart,The great seal of clear light dissolves into the state of abiding.Lord of the Dharma of the Vajra Speech yoga,At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.By the caṇḍālī of the navel wheel,The syllable HŪṂ at the crown melts into the central channel,Sporting in the glory of co-emergent great bliss,Lord of the Dharma of the Vajra Mind yoga,At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.May all the Victors of the ten directions and their spiritual heirs—When inviting them through the power of pure aspiration,The Tathāgatas of their respective directionsPerform offerings through the manifestation of their forms.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.By the principal deity of the Mañjuśrīvajra maṇḍala,I clearly dreamt of being given an excellent precious vase,Filled with the water of the Dharma discussionsBetween Mañjughoṣa and the noble Maitreya.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.Upon a throne adorned with many precious jewels,The omniscient Bu-ston Rin-chen-grubHanded over the volume of the Guhyasamāja Root Tantra,And said, "Be the master of this."At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.Having bestowed the volume, he blessed it three timesUpon my head with mantra and mudrā.The key points of the "Mixing and Transference" of Mar-pa of Lho-bragAre surely the pith instructions of the Tantras and the Noble Ones.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.When performing the practice of the Cakrasaṃvara maṇḍala,You clearly perceived the maṇḍalas directly.By the hosts of ḍākinīs of the three outer, inner, and secret abodes,You were delighted with the offering of vajra songs.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.When you performed the practice of subduing the demonic hosts,You were radiant, like the luster of refined, purified gold,Surrounded by a halo of light like ten million suns;You directly beheld the Buddha, the great subduer of Māra.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.Having made the Lord’s body and the Victorious One’s body, speech, and mindInseparable, you overwhelmed the demonic forces,And when the Dharma protectors vanquished the demonic clans,The great sound of the defeat of the demonic army resounded.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.By the ocean-like assembly of Dharma protectors, directly,Just as Vajradhara had commanded in times past,To uphold and propagate your teachings,I practice accordingly with a mind of supreme devotion.At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.In the realm of Tuṣita, before the Invincible Dharma Lord,The Son of the Victorious One, known as Mañjuśrī-Nyingpo,Whom Mañjughoṣa and the Lord of SecretsClearly prophesied, the venerable Lord of Dharma—At the feet of the glorious Guru, I pray.Having prayed with a mind of faith in this way,You who dispel the suffering of beings equal to the expanse of space,In every life, may the venerable GuruCare for me; bless me to uphold the sacred Dharma.Please cause the innate primordial wisdom of great bliss to arise.Please dispel the stains of the delusion of reifying things as real.Please cut through the web of doubt regarding the nature of mind.Swiftly bless me to become just like you.Please cause the wisdom of hearing, reflection, and meditation to increase.Please bestow the supreme and common accomplishments.Swiftly bless me to become just like you.I offer clouds of Samantabhadra’s offerings, equal to the sky.I confess each of the misdeeds and downfalls accumulated since beginningless time.I rejoice in all the virtues of the Sons of the Victorious Ones,And I exhort you to turn the wheel of Dharma and not pass into nirvana.By the ocean of merit accumulated in this way,May all beings sport in the glory of meditative stabilization,May excellence increase like the waxing moon,And may the teachings of the omniscient Victor flourish.
